comments.text:
I’m buying it today because it’s the best option out there. I got a 33% discount by purchasing directly from the official Tata AIG website. After comparing with other companies, I found that Tata AIG offers an all-in-one plan, which is exactly what I was looking for.

I also did some research on their customer care, and it’s top-notch. In contrast, Aditya Birla insurance never even called me back when I provided my contact number. Niva Bupa had 44 complaints per 10,000, the highest among the competitors. Star Insurance is blacklisted by most hospitals in Delhi, while Care Insurance has a low incurred percentage and poor customer satisfaction. HDFC ERGO is much more expensive, only promoting a high claim ratio as their selling point.

In the end, Tata AIG Medicare Premier stood out because it doesn’t require any additional riders—all essential coverage is included in the policy. The customer care is also very transparent and satisfying. The technology and website are excellent, and their claim ratio is almost as good as HDFC ERGO’s. Plus, it’s used by many Tata employees, who get a discount on the premium.

Tata AIG’s policy offers great benefits, including annual health checkups, OPD coverage, dental care, and consumable cover. Meanwhile, Aditya Birla charges an additional ₹3500 for equipment coverage (such as ventilators), but ventilator costs in an ICU can be as high as ₹15,000 per day. When you factor that in, Aditya Birla’s pricing ends up matching HDFC ERGO’s.

Currently, Tata AIG offers the best value for money, with no subl-imits and a clear commitment to covering the full hospital bill. I’ve done a month of research and this is my conclusion.
